title: Randomized polynomial time via reductions
statement: The class of languages that reduce by a many-one reduction to some language in P equals the union, over all natural numbers $c$, of the classes decidable by bounded-error randomized machines in time bounded by a constant multiple of $n \mapsto n^c+1$.
